title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1020 | 彗星跳绳、面条海虫、长毛蜗牛
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🌠 一颗彗星藏在太阳系上方“跳绳”，欧几里得望远镜在拍星系时意外抓拍到了它！
🍝 印度洋深海里发现了新的海虫，像会走路的意大利面，用触手抓食物、用吸盘粘在岩石上！
🐌 九千九百万年前，一只长毛的蜗牛困在金色的树胶里变成了琥珀，毛还看得见！

📖 Word of the day: amber（琥珀）

🎮 猜谜时间：我是脏兮兮的大雪球、拖着闪亮的尾巴，从太阳系头顶飞过，几千年才拜访一次太阳——我是谁？

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🌠 A new comet photo bombed a galaxy picture — it's flying like a jump rope over the top of the solar system!
🍝 New deep-sea worms look like walking spaghetti, grabbing food with noodle tentacles and sticking to rocks with suction cups!
🐌 A hairy snail got stuck in golden tree sap ninety nine million years ago — and the sap turned into amber!

📖 Word of the day: amber

🎮 Riddle time: I'm a giant dirty snowball with a sparkly tail, flying over the top of the solar system — what am I?

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. amber（琥珀）
golden, hard tree sap that can trap tiny animals for millions of years
例：a piece of amber（一块琥珀）

2. comet（彗星）
a giant snowball in space with a sparkly tail
例：a new comet（一颗新彗星）

3. tentacle（触角）
a long, bendy arm some sea animals use to grab food
例：spaghetti-like tentacles（像面条一样的触角）

4. orbit（轨道）
the path one thing travels around another thing in space
例：the comet's orbit（这颗彗星的轨道）
